card.name: Words just before heart or vascular terms
card.fires_on: The word "of" in the overdose-treatment sentence "priorities are the reestablishment of a patent and protected airway". It also fires on words like "CV" or "adequate" where a heart or blood-flow term is expected next.

modes.label: Overdose priorities sentence
modes.description: The word "of" after "reestablishment" in the standard overdose-treatment text.
modes.example: Treatment of Overdose In case of overdose, priorities are the reestablishment<< of>> a patent and protected airway and institution

modes.label: Cardiovascular lead-in words
modes.description: A modifier such as "CV" or "adequate" right before a word like effects or blood flow.
modes.example: Use of celecoxib may blunt the<< CV>> effects

card.writes: It pushes the output toward heart and vascular words and away from words starting with "Ar" or "art".
card.plain: It fires on a small word where the next word might be about the heart or blood vessels.
